verdict.rationale: RUN documents an AI-powered virtual assistant that answers payroll and HR questions in natural language (adp-run-docs-16), so there is a first-party natural-language interface. There is no evidence that it can carry out actions such as running payroll, adding employees or changing settings, so it supports asking questions rather than operating the product. missing for 10: natural-language commands that execute payroll/HR actions, documentation of the assistant's scope and depth, independent or hands-on corroboration.
